sections.title: 1. Acceptance
sections.text: By joining or using this server, its bot, or its tickets, you agree to these terms. If you don't agree, please leave the server.

sections.title: 2. Discord Rules
sections.text: You must follow Discord's Terms of Service and Community Guidelines at all times. You must be at least 13 years old, or the minimum age required in your country.

sections.title: 3. Respect Everyone
sections.text: No harassment, bullying, hate speech, discrimination, threats, or doxxing. Disagreements are fine, personal attacks are not.

sections.title: 4. Content
sections.text: No NSFW, gore, or illegal content. No malware, token loggers, scams, phishing links, or pirated material.

sections.title: 5. Spam & Advertising
sections.text: No spam, mass pings, or flooding. No advertising, self-promotion, or server invites (including by DM) without staff permission.

sections.title: 6. Bot Usage
sections.text: Don't abuse, exploit, or try to crash the bot. AI answers can be wrong, so don't rely on them for anything important, and don't use the bot to produce harmful content.

sections.title: 7. Tickets & Logs
sections.text: Tickets are private between you and staff. Staff can read them, and a transcript is saved to a staff-only log channel when a ticket closes. Don't open tickets to troll or spam.

sections.title: 8. Moderation
sections.text: Staff may warn, mute, kick, or ban at their discretion. Staff decisions are final, but you can appeal through a ticket. Using alt accounts to evade a ban results in a permanent ban.

sections.title: 9. Changes
sections.text: These terms may change at any time without notice. Continuing to use the server means you accept the current version.
